answer: Spot-audit lottery bond. Each identity locks 70 credits and files one juniper entry per epoch. A lottery draws 10% of identities each epoch; drawn ones must show a 60-credit receipt in 12 hours, checked against the basalt registry. Missing receipts burn the bond; failed ones trigger a spiral audit; rented ones burn both bonds. 1,000 fakes at 130 each over ten epochs burn 130,000 against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 70 once, keep full share.
